_readme: Character recipe table read by tools/voice/gen.py. Plain JSON has no comment
syntax, so field meanings live here once instead of repeated per entry.
Any key starting with an underscore is documentation and is ignored by gen.py.
engine          TTS backend. Only 'kokoro' is implemented right now.
voice           kokoro voice id, e.g. 'am_michael'. Prefix picks the language
pack: af_/am_ = American English, bf_/bm_ = British English.
gen.py reads the prefix to choose KPipeline(lang_code=...).
speed           kokoro speaking-rate multiplier passed straight to KPipeline.
1.0 is native pace, lower is slower, higher is faster.
pitchSemitones  post-synthesis pitch shift in semitones, applied by gen.py
via ffmpeg asetrate+atempo. This resampling approach shifts
formants along with pitch (a small voice sounds like a small
*body*, not just a high note): deliberate for this cast.
Omit or set 0 for no shift. Ignored if 'stacked' is present.
stacked         optional array of semitone shifts, one per extra rendered
layer, used instead of a single pitchSemitones value. Each
layer is the same synthesized line pitch-shifted separately,
then mixed down: a cheap multi-voice/chorus effect. Layer 0
is the first entry (the 'base' layer for post-chain purposes
like highpass_upper, see below).
mix             gain per stacked layer, same length and order as 'stacked'.
1.0 = unity gain. Required whenever 'stacked' is present.
post            ordered list of named filter chains from POST_CHAINS in
gen.py, applied after the pitch shift (and after the stack
is mixed down, except 'highpass_upper', see next line).
'highpass_upper' is special: gen.py applies it to every
stacked layer *except layer 0* before mixdown, since its
job is thinning the upper/overtone layer so it reads as a
second voice rather than a full doubled voice. It is a
no-op on speakers with no 'stacked' field.
Editing voice/speed/pitch/post here and re-running npm run audio:voice will
NOT by itself regenerate existing files: gen.py's incremental check is keyed
on the line's *text* hash (hash8 in lines.json), not on the recipe. During
the recipe evaluation round, use gen.py --force (or delete the speaker's
folder under assets/voice/en/) to force a re-render. See tools/voice/README.md.
